purpose: Friendly Utopia lore visitors used by the autonomous library circulation system.

gleebs.basis: Purple/green cat-rabbit companion who builds/inhabits a mechanical body.
gleebs.visual_translation: Mechanical green/purple body, expressive face display, asymmetric cat/rabbit ears.

sola.basis: Yellow companion figure associated with a humanoid frame; explicitly states her name.

bird_companion.basis: Unnamed bird-shaped companion projection present in the companion-rights scene.

wheeled_companion.basis: Unnamed wheeled companion present in the same scene.

rules: Lore visitors use the same borrowing, returning, service, pathfinding and collision systems as generic visitors.
Named lore visitors are not duplicated while already active or while they still have an outstanding physical book loan.
No permanent lore HUD is added; names appear only as short world-space labels or while making a service request.
